head: Super 909 Drums: free 909-style drum machine app for iPhone and Mac
dek: AudioKit Pro released Super 909 Drums on 20 November, a free synth-based drum machine modelled on the classic 909 sound, for iPhone, iPad and Mac. The same day it was #65 in Music on the US App Store's free chart.
details: You can tap beats on drum pads, add flams, ratchets and swing, and set a last step per track for polyrhythms. It works on its own or as an AUv3 plug-in, sends MIDI and syncs by MIDI clock or Ableton Link, and presets sync between Mac, iPhone and iPad. The listing says it isn't affiliated with Roland, which owns the TR-909 name, and that VoiceOver works in 14 languages.
where: iPhone, iPad (iOS 15 or later) and Mac (macOS 12 or later); free
means: If you make beats on a phone or in a music app that takes AUv3 plug-ins, you can try a 909-style drum machine without paying for it.
todo: Download it from the App Store and open it on its own, or load it as an AUv3 plug-in in your music app.
